# gardience_change_window (Resource)

A change window: changes to a node group (patching, states, runbooks) wait until the window is open. Work for the group is held and runs when the window opens; an admin can override it in an emergency, with a reason in the audit log.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Changes to Linux machines wait for the weekend evening window.
resource "gardience_change_window" "linux_weekend" {
  id        = "linux-weekend"
  nodegroup = "Linux"
  days      = ["sat", "sun"]
  start     = "22:00"
  end       = "23:59"
  tz        = "America/Chicago"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `days` (List of String) Days it is open: `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun`.
- `end` (String) Closes at, `HH:MM`.
- `id` (String) Your id for the window: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
- `nodegroup` (String) The node group the window applies to.
- `start` (String) Opens at, `HH:MM`.

### Optional

- `tz` (String) Time zone, for example `America/Chicago`. Default `UTC`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import gardience_change_window.linux_weekend linux-weekend
```
